title: The waiting page's remaining narrow-screen faults that #2450 leaves out are fixed
why: Coordinator 11:36 CST Nov 9, from lane page-narrow-word-breaks (#2450): #2450 fixes part of step page-narrow-word-breaks and leaves these out: the .dcap caption size; the "(permission|-denied)" failure-line break; the "Question|s" tab labels; the sent panel scrolling 9 px sideways at 180 px (on the base); and part B, words wider than their box. Harm: the owner reads the page on a phone, and these still break or cut text at narrow widths with large text.
note: Part B keeps the a11y.md rule. Measurements for each item are on step page-narrow-word-breaks. A screen lane: designer first, design reviewer after.
